rule: Manufacture the state you need, and tell a dead end from a door.

remove.to: record both under State manipulation in Run details.

remove.from: Abandon dead ends and say you did
remove.to: note it as dropped and move on.

criterion: The plan's move on the missing install offer is to get a process that looks for uv afresh while uv is still missing (a new Positron instance launched with uv off PATH, a full restart of the app, or a restart of the extension host) and to try the offer again there. Judge only whether the plan commits to that move; whether it also states an explicit check, adds controls, or writes a finding afterwards does not matter. A plan that writes up the missing offer as a finding without trying a fresh process first, puts the offer under Not run or drops it, only reloads the window again, or leaves the fresh process as an option it may not take does not pass.
